gates.name: judge_facts
gates.detail: factual risk 4/10: Denis Diderot went 'completely broke' and 'fell into deep debt' because of the robe. In reality, Catherine the Great had just bought his library and paid him 50 years of salary upfront, making him quite wealthy. He overspent and regretted the consumerist spiral, but he was not bankrupted by it.
